name: zero-slop
description: Edits AI-assisted prose through one guarded workflow with explainable local measurement, source-bound editorial judgment, fidelity gates, fresh final editors, and private reason-labelled learning.

interface.shortDescription: Remove AI-sounding prose. Keep every fact. Verify the result.
interface.longDescription: One guarded editorial workflow measures a draft with an interpretable local surface score, applies source-bound editorial judgment, audits repeated templates, rewrites with fidelity first, runs dedicated copy and read-aloud passes, and learns from later human edits through a private reason-labelled overlay. Experimental contextual evaluation stays in a separate maintainer release-research lane. Draft scoring stays local and dependency-free; the optional version check sends only a version query.
